newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower in thin trade, await data.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower in thin trade, await data.

text.p: NYCE Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled weaker on speculative selling and local liquidation, dealers said.

Prices skidded the the day's lows when stops were elected at 107.25 in November, pressuring the contract to 104.90. Trade scale-down buying supported the market towards the middle of the day's range, but additonal selling came in on the close and weakened prices further.
November FCOJ settled 2.70 cent a lb lower at 105.45, having ranged from 108.75 to 104.89. The remaining months closed 2.05 and 3.05 weaker.
Activity remained dull, with volume estimated at only 1,450 lots.
"You see this move and it looks like a significant range, but it's on nothing," said a dealer in reference to today's volume.
He said activity is likely to remain dull ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Florida crop estimate, released next month.
